title: Recording: Golden Blunders, Everybody Wins, Angel In Disguise by Ringo Starr | 1991
content:
Studio F, Los Angeles
Producer: Peter Asher
Engineer: Frank Wolf

Ringo Starr continued recording three songs for his tenth solo album, Time Takes Time, on 12 September 1991.

The backing track for ‘Golden Blunders’ had been recorded on 9 September, with more overdubs added on 11 and 13 September.

Also worked on was ‘Everybody Wins’, which was included on the ‘Don’t Go Where The Road Don’t Go’ CD single in September 1992. Starr re-recorded the song for 2010’s Y Not, retitling it ‘Everyone Wins’.

The day’s final song, ‘Angel In Disguise’, had also been started on 9 September. More overdubs were recorded on 13 and 18 September, but the song, a co-write by Starr and Paul McCartney, was left unreleased.
